name: quake-atlas
description: Interactive explorer for historical earthquakes (FastAPI + DuckDB backend, React + deck.gl frontend).

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd .. && npm install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn quakes.api:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.sample: cd backend && uv run quakes sample
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && uv run uvicorn quakes.api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.prepare-simulator: cd backend && uv run quakes prepare-simulator
